whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Tasty Treat Restro & Cafe,

I noticed your rooftop cafe has stellar 4.7★ reviews on Boring Canal Road, but lacked a dedicated interactive table reservation and digital menu ordering system for weekend diners.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, full menu showcase, aur rooftop vibe gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://tasty-treat-cafe.lovable.app/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Tasty Treat Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Tasty Treat Restro & Cafe on Boring Canal Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with a direct WhatsApp table booking system and complete digital menu showcase for your Anandpuri patrons. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact specials aur branding integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
